subject: TLI robust values went bad after 0.6.13

messages.author: b3e070da0cbe576c
messages.subject: TLI robust values went bad after 0.6.13
parts:
Hi all,

Lately I have been running a longitudinal mediation analysis through the lavaan package in R to test a mediation model.

Initially, I ran the syntax in version 0.6.8 of the package and obtained good fit measures. However, when installing more recent versions of the package, I get TLI (robust) and CFI (robust) values that I don't find in previous versions (from 0.6.8 to 0.6.12) and that compromise my model (bad fit).

I would like to know why the results are different when I use the most recent versions of the package and if the results I got in older versions are compromised or not.

I can provide more details such as my syntax or more info regarding my data.

Thank you very much for the help!!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: TLI robust values went bad after 0.6.13
parts:
If you are using missing = "fiml", then the 'robust' cfi/tli/rmsea are
now (since 0.6-13) based on:

Zhang, X., & Savalei, V. (2022). New computations for RMSEA and CFI
following FIML and TS estimation with missing data. Psychological Methods.

Yves.
